keyFiles.why: Every logged-in page: session check, menu from the backend, sidebar + header
Main way to READ data: server-side GraphQL POST, adds token / merchant-id, caching
Main way to WRITE data: server action GraphQL POST + cache refresh after a mutation
Login: NextAuth credentials → GraphQL login → token kept in the session cookie
Runs before every request: language prefix + redirect to /login when not signed in
Where token, userId and merchantId come from (merchant = env TEMP_MERCHANT_ID)
Turns src/graphql/*.graphql into typed XxxDocument objects (needs a running backend)
The table used by almost every list page
The create / edit pop-up used by most screens
Reusable zod form rules (required text, required combobox …)
Confirm dialog, loading backdrop, combobox loading helpers
